fieldNotes.buildingIdentification: Roster gave no street address and the geocode (APPROXIMATE) was ~5 km off. News sources place the new Frito-Lay DSD distribution center at 3221 Anton St, Prichard AL 36612 — ~25,000 sq ft, broke ground June 2024, operational June 2025, $8M. OSM places Anton St at ~30.7408,-88.1194. The best-candidate building is a large white metal warehouse with a yellow horizontal stripe on the west side of Anton St (~30.74010,-88.12010), visible in April-2026 Street View. The yellow stripe matches Frito-Lay brand color, but no Frito-Lay logo/sign is visible to positively confirm, and the building looks larger and older than a brand-new 25k sq ft build — identification is NOT certain.
fieldNotes.truckGate: No barrier arm, gate, or checkpoint visible. The building fronts an open industrial street (Anton St) with no perimeter fence — open-access layout.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth visible; small DSD hub.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Small dock bank on the NW building face with a few trailers backed in; ~8 doors estimated (0-10 band).
fieldNotes.dropArea: Only a handful of trailers in the yard; no dedicated drop lot.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town light-industrial district of Prichard, AL — wooded surroundings; classed Rural.
fieldNotes.confidence: Low overall — the facility is newly built/leased, the exact building could not be positively confirmed from imagery, and current Maxar satellite may predate the completed DC.
